texts.arguments: Ms. Asha Tiwari, learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits, that admittedly the food sample was sent to a non-accredited lab, based on which penalty has been imposed upon appellant. 3. Ms. Tiwari places reliance on a judgment passed by a Division Bench of the Bombay High Court in Nestle India Limited vs. Food Safety and Standards Authority of India & Ors.1.
